journal.how_it_works: Six citation eras from the TANG, each declaring its own form AND its own standard of what counts as evidence. The citation forms are the argument, not the abstracts. Entry density falls as the eras advance because the citation form consumes the scholarship.
journal.declared_limit: No entry imagines the Epistle disproved, superseded or forgotten. The editorial note names this as a constraint of the genre and instructs the reader to supply what the library cannot.

corrections_and_false_leads: I reported thousands of uncollected forward citations. There are 46 declared across three deposits. My figure came from reading FORWARD LIBRARY (2031-3000) as an entry count when it is a DATE RANGE — the same class of error as judging duplication by byte count.

'Forward Library' is overloaded. In the Space Ark specifications FL₀ is the CANONICAL DOCUMENT STORE, an architectural component of the seven-tuple, not a bibliography. Only three deposits carry a forward-dated bibliography under that name.
39 deposits appeared to carry Forward Libraries; 36 merely mention the term.
